title: Multiply Strings
description: Multiply two non-negative integers represented as strings using digit arrays.

data.text: Given two non-negative integers `num1` and `num2` as strings, return the product of `num1` and `num2` as a string without using built-in big-integer libraries.

data.title: Add in a loop O(n * m)
int[] product O(n * m)
What improved?
data.text: The digit array captures each place-value multiplication once. Instead of adding `num1` repeatedly, we place partial products directly into the right positions.
